stories.title: Efficient Martin getting more minutes for Raptors
stories.summary: Alijah Martin has been waiting for a moment like this.

stories.title: Ontario father finds unanchored soccer nets in community where son died
stories.summary: The father of a 15-year-old who was killed by an unsecured soccer net said he was "disappointed" to find non-anchored goalposts in the town where his son died at in 2017.

stories.title: Barrett, Murray-Boyles put on Raptors injured list
stories.summary: The Toronto Raptors have sidelined forwards RJ Barrett and Collin Murray-Boyles.

stories.title: Former colleges and universities minister refuses to answer OSAP questions
stories.summary: Ontario's former minister of colleges and universities, who presided over the file for three years until 2024, is refusing to answer questions about a growing OSAP scandal.

stories.title: Up to $650K offered for 8 fugitives on Canada’s most wanted list
stories.summary: Rewards totaling up to $650,000 are being offered for information leading to the arrests of eight fugitives on Canada's most wanted list.

stories.title: Ford says he won’t impose AI data centres on unwilling municipalities, bolstering municipal moratoriums
stories.summary: Premier Ford said he plans to sit down with Mississauga's mayor to discuss the proposed data centres in his city and indicated that he's willing to respect the moratorium.

stories.title: Graves has career-high playing time for Raptors
stories.summary: Allen Graves is making the most of his playing time as injuries continue to plague the Toronto Raptors.

stories.title: Raptors’ losing skid stretches to six games
stories.summary: Anthony Davis had a double-double with 25 points and 14 rebounds as his Washington Wizards beat the undermanned Raptors 103-99 on Wednesday as Toronto lost its sixth straight.

stories.title: Ford admits his French needs work after shaky Montreal speech
stories.summary: Critics of the Ford government told reporters they didn’t find it funny that the premier of Canada’s largest province is unable to speak French, an official language.

stories.title: Ford puts onus on Ottawa ahead of Stellantis Brampton plant talks
stories.summary: The Ford government is pointing to Ottawa to do the heavy lifting on Stellantis, despite Joly urging that they need to be on the same page.
